[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This facility, recorded in this registry simply as Switch12, is part of the Switch Las Vegas Core Campus in Clark County, Nevada. An earlier pass on file for this operator traced the companys history and its December 2022 acquisition by DigitalBridge and IFM Investors, and confirmed via direct fetch that the operators own locations page publishes no street addresses for any campus or building. This session searched a data center industry aggregator directorys full listing of Switch facilities in the Las Vegas area and found no facility distinctly named Switch 12 or Switch12, only a differently numbered, already separately tracked sibling row, Switch Las Vegas 12, at its own distinct address. Reverse geocoding this rows own stored coordinates through a third party service returned 7000 Lindell Road, Las Vegas, NV at 0.9 confidence, a street number not matching any other Switch address already on file nearby, but this session found no second, independent source naming this specific building at that address, so consistent with this projects standard that a geocoding services own confidence score is not itself external corroboration, no address is asserted for this row.
